parsing_traps: Portfolio Statement (p150): Albany-Supermarket fair-value cell shows a dash because it was reclassified to 'investment property held for divestment' (carried separately at US$23,800k). Its value IS in the portfolio and is stored as market_valuation with status=held_for_sale. 'Investment properties, at valuation' 729,060k EXCLUDES it; total appraised value 752,860k INCLUDES it.

SFP 'Investment properties' 749,872k = at-valuation 729,060 + Right-of-use asset 20,812 (Wallington ground lease). market_valuation figures use the per-property fair values, not the ROU-inflated SFP line.
Hudson Valley Plaza FY2023 value 51,200k included the Lowe's and Sam's Club buildings (divested Aug 2024); FY2024 value 27,900k excludes them (partial divestment). Not a valuation error.

DPU: Distribution Statement DPU line 4.06c is the FY2024 full-year DPU (= 1H2024 2.01c + 2H2024 2.05c). The cash 'Total distribution to Unitholders' 24,175k mixes 2H2023 + 1H2024 tranches paid during the year — different from the declared-for-year DPU basis.
EPU weighted-average units 584,640k (Note 23) differs from period-end units-in-issue 589,691k (SFP / Note 16) — the former is the weighted average for EPU/DPU, the latter the closing unit base.
